title: The form
summary: The founder's P10 note answered: the memo window, mono keys, date and triple labels are gone; the kit's .ac-field form (18px labels above 22px inputs on 64px rows, 15px hints only where a topic needs one, one 'All fields required.' line, the 56px outlined submit) sits under the h1's columns, and three plain steps under the lede's column, held in view while the form scrolls, say what happens when you press send.

reference.site: GoNimbly (founder's recordings, refs-r9/GONIMBLY-STUDY.md) · the round-9 kit (frag/int-kit/S)
reference.borrowed: Few, big, sentence-case labels; the form as the first object under the head.
reference.kelwin: The kit's .ac-field on graphite (no paper: a form is not a document), the no-CRM mailto said plainly, outlined submit, no red.

copy: [K] labels: Your name · Company · Work email · Topic · Message
[K, retold] email hint 'Use a company address. It keeps this inbox usable for real requests.' (was 'We reply to company addresses…': 'reply' now said twice on the page, in the h1 and step 3)

[R] topics grouped plainly: Working with Kelwin (Understanding what Kelwin does · Exploring a future engagement · A fixed-scope project [N, plan §8] · Ask for an invitation to The Lab [Q4]) · Reading (A research document · A readout or case study · Field notes) · Everything else (Partnerships · Press and speaking · Careers · Something else)

hints only where a topic needs one (no default filler): project 'Name the project, or the piece of the system you need.' [N] (hidden when a project reference is pinned: the reference says it); Lab 'Invitations go to install clients first, then to the best fit. We reply either way.' [N, Q4]; readout 'No client readout has been cleared for publication yet. We’ll send the specimen now, and the first real one when a client clears it.' [R, Q2]; research 'The first, the Revenue Entropy Index, is due in Q4 2026. We’ll send it the day it’s out.' [N, Q4]; careers 'Questions about a seat or its terms go to careers@kelwin.co (address to be confirmed).' [N, Q3] — that topic's mailto goes to careers@ (proposed)

[R] steps: 1 'Your own mail app opens, with the message filled in.' 2 'You send it from your address. Nothing is sent from this page.' 3 'The founder reads it and replies within two working days, or one for an audit booking.' [Q1, Q3: both reply times, said once]

deep links: ?topic= dossier · research · notes · careers · engagement · project · lab; ?ref= shown as plain text under the topic ('Project: Email deliverability' for ?topic=project&ref=email-deliverability; otherwise 'Regarding: …'), removable
[K] message hint 'As rough as you like. Bullet points are fine.'
submit by topic: 'Send the message' [K] · 'Ask for the document' [R] · 'Ask for an invitation' [N]
[N] after send: 'Your mail app should have opened. If it didn’t, write to audit@kelwin.co.' + Copy the address
phone: ≤1023 the form takes the measure and the steps follow as a row of three; ≤767 the steps stack and the pair stacks (kit). The topic's value is set as text under an invisible native select, so a long topic ('Ask for an invitation to The Lab') wraps at 320 instead of clipping. Checked at 320, 390, 834.
motion: entrance (the page's one body moment): the fields rise in turn, then the three steps.
interaction: the topic rewrites its hint, the submit's words and the address; a pinned reference can be removed (the project hint returns); Copy confirms in words.
on the live site: the steps are position: sticky beside the form (top 128px, under the condensed nav); plays once when the form scrolls into view; reduced motion = final state, no timers.
notes: A working form (no specimen tag). Root keeps id="write". kit_request: the kit's select clips long values on phones; this fragment and careers-bench overlay the value as text. Deep links to try: page-contact.html?topic=project&ref=email-deliverability · ?topic=lab · ?topic=careers. Round-9 fix pass: the default hint ('Pick the nearest one. Every topic reaches the same inbox.') is gone; a pinned project reference replaces the project hint; the one-option 'The Lab' group folded into 'Working with Kelwin'; careers questions route to careers@ (proposed); the steps are sticky.
